description: Source code for transaction management in the BoltDB key/value store, including transaction lifecycle, page handling, and statistics.

classes.name: Tx
classes.description: Represents a database transaction, supporting read-only and read/write modes, with methods for managing buckets, committing, rolling back, and writing data.

classes.name: TxStats
classes.description: Holds statistics about transaction operations such as page allocations, cursor creations, node operations, rebalances, spills, and writes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a transaction with the database, copying meta information and setting up the root bucket.

methods.name: ID
methods.description: Returns the transaction ID.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Returns the database instance associated with the transaction.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the database as seen by this transaction.

methods.name: Writable
methods.description: Indicates whether the transaction has write permissions.

methods.name: Cursor
methods.description: Creates a cursor for iterating over the root bucket.

methods.name: Stats
methods.description: Retrieves current transaction statistics.

methods.name: Inspect
methods.description: Returns the structure of the database.

methods.name: Bucket
methods.description: Retrieves a bucket by name.

methods.name: CreateBucket
methods.description: Creates a new bucket.

methods.name: CreateBucketIfNotExists
methods.description: Creates a new bucket if it does not already exist.

methods.name: DeleteBucket
methods.description: Deletes a specified bucket.

methods.name: MoveBucket
methods.description: Moves a sub-bucket from one bucket to another.

methods.name: ForEach
methods.description: Executes a function for each bucket in the root.

methods.name: OnCommit
methods.description: Adds a handler to be executed after successful commit.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the transaction, writing changes to disk and updating meta information.

methods.name: commitFreelist
methods.description: Allocates and writes a new freelist during commit.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the transaction, discarding all changes.

methods.name: nonPhysicalRollback
methods.description: Performs rollback without reloading free pages from disk.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Performs rollback, reloading free pages if necessary.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transaction, releasing resources and updating statistics.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Deprecated: Writes the entire database to a writer.

methods.name: WriteTo
methods.description: Writes the entire database to a writer.

methods.name: sameFile
methods.description: Checks if two files refer to the same underlying file.

methods.name: CopyFile
methods.description: Copies the entire database to a specified file.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a contiguous block of pages.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes dirty pages to disk.

methods.name: writeMeta
methods.description: Writes meta information to disk.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns a reference to a page by ID, checking for dirty pages first.

methods.name: forEachPage
methods.description: Iterates over each page within a page, executing a callback.

methods.name: forEachPageInternal
methods.description: Internal recursive function to iterate over pages.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: Returns page info for a given page number.
